cKs-GxTKSPo.description:
Sponsored and Approved by Nintendo!

The Dr. Mario World game is free-to-start and you can download the game now on iOS and Android! 
Dr. Mario World is a puzzle game that features hundreds of stages across several worlds, with new worlds coming on a regular basis. Each stage offers a fun and absorbing puzzle that tasks the player with clearing all of the viruses on-screen, or other goals such as obtaining a certain number of virus coins hidden in brick blocks.
Match capsules with viruses and watch the viruses disappear! Simply match three objects of the same color vertically or horizontally to clear them. Take your time, because each puzzling stage’s configuration of viruses must be cleared using a limited number of capsules.
To aid in completing each stage, players can also strategically use the remaining half of capsules, or drag capsules through obstacles to a given location, or use special in-game items, like rainbow capsules or hammers.
Dr. Mario and friends have put on their lab coats and are ready to eliminate those pesky viruses. Collect Doctors and Assistants, utilizing their unique skills to help you solve the puzzles in each stage.
Doctors have skills that can used by the player when the skill meter is full
Up to two assistants can be active that will give the player different bonus benefits in Stage mode and Versus mode


Multiplayer capabilities include:
Versus mode to play head-to-head against another player
In Stage mode, see your friends’ progress and scores compared to your own
New doctors, assistant, and stages are continually added
With multiplayer features, Dr. Mario World is a puzzle game that is also fun with friends and family. Play together with friends and family locally or around the world by sending them stamina-giving hearts to use in stage mode or challenging them to a one-on-one showdown.
The year 2020 is the 30thanniversary of the Dr. Mario franchise. 
A persistent online connection and a compatible smartphone are required to play Dr. Mario World.

pss2f1kvkM8.description:
Here is a brief Summary about this video:

The overall point of this video is that we ask that YouTube implement better procedures to protect children to ensure they are not overworked, filming in a safe environment and properly compensated.

- We don't agree that children should be filmed every single day of their lives. We believe some topics and situations should be private. That's our opinion.

- Do we believe that children should be allowed to express themselves and create content? Yes, of course we do. We do it and we do our best to maintain a healthy balance of filming and non-filming activities. Do we believe other families do the same? Yes we do! 

- Are we against home schooling? No. We just believe that there may be families abusing the concept of homeschooling to create more content.

- We want to do our part to protect children on YouTube so they do not fall down a similar path to many child stars of the 80's. 

Check out Katie Morton's Channel Here: https://www.youtube.com/user/KatiMorton

vipt8LalDcc.description:
This World Refugee Day, meet the people behind the crisis - and discover what makes them #MoreThanARefugee.

The International Rescue Committee (IRC) invited seven YouTube creators to get to know refugees around the world. See more stories at youtube.com/youtube

Learn more about the IRC and YouTube’s partnership at https://www.Rescue.org/YouTube

Never before has the world witnessed such a dramatic scale of human suffering. In fact, more people have been forced to flee their homes by conflict and crisis today than at any time since World War II.

Last year, the number of people displaced by conflict worldwide surpassed 65 million. In Syria alone, six years of war have driven 13.5 million people from their homes. Millions more have been uprooted in Afghanistan, Nigeria, Yemen and elsewhere. If displaced people could form a country, it would be the 21st largest in the world, with a population greater than Great Britain’s.Only 1% of the world’s refugees are resettled to a third country.

More about IRC:

The International Rescue Committee responds to the world’s worst humanitarian crises. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is at work in over 40 countries and 28 offices across the U.S. helping people to survive and regain control of their future.. Learn more at www.rescue.org/YouTube and follow the IRC on Twitter & Facebook. YouTube Creators for Change is a new initiative from YouTube dedicated to amplifying the voices of role models who are tackling difficult social issues with their channels. From combating hate speech, to countering xenophobia and extremism, to simply making the case for greater tolerance and empathy toward others, these creators are helping generate positive social change with their global fan bases.
